seo.title: Integer Slate — component reference
seo.description: One page exercising every component in the built-in library.

settings.heading: Every component, one page
settings.subheading: Each block below is a registered component rendered from JSON. Nothing here is hand-written HTML.

settings.body:
This page is content/pages/components.json in the storefront repo. The renderer walks the JSON tree, resolves design tokens to CSS custom properties, and emits per-node scoped CSS for anything responsive.

Every colour, space and type value you see comes from content/config/tokens.json — change that file and this page restyles without being edited.

settings.heading: Feature grid — three across, stacking on mobile

items.title: Responsive by construction
items.body: Column counts are per breakpoint. The renderer emits mobile as the base rule and larger breakpoints as min-width overrides.

items.title: Tokens, not values
items.body: A setting holds { token: 'brand.primary' }, never a hex code. That is what lets one component render on-brand for every client.

items.title: Unknown types degrade
items.body: A component this runtime does not recognise renders nothing and logs a warning. The rest of the page is unaffected.

settings.body: Columns is a layout container. It accepts children, which most components deliberately do not — the manifest decides, so a document cannot smuggle children into a component that has no place to put them.
Nesting is how a merchant composes a page. There is no free canvas and no absolute positioning: structure comes from containers, which is what keeps a page mobile-safe without anyone checking.

This paragraph is hidden on mobile via hideOn. Narrow your browser below 768px and it disappears — the renderer emits a bounded media query for exactly that breakpoint, so tablet and desktop are unaffected.

settings.html:
Custom HTML escape hatch

This block came through rawHtml and was sanitised on render. A <script> tag, an onclick attribute and a non-video <iframe> were all included in the source and none of them survived.

This div kept its text but lost its handler.

settings.note: This type is not registered. It renders nothing and logs a warning — the page around it is untouched.
